annotations.title: Draft an order from a chat

description: Reads one chat, named by id, with the AI and writes an order draft from it: the products of the number’s list the customer asked for, with the list’s prices (a product the list does not have is a custom item with no price), the delivery details and the payment method, each with the messages it came from; fields the AI was unsure of are marked Check. The chat’s open draft, if it has one, is updated instead. Counts as one AI conversation. Nothing is sent to the customer. Returns the order.

from.description: composer when it is the composer’s /order; seller otherwise.

id.description: The chat to read, by its cnv_ id.

name: draft_order_from_conversation
title: Draft an order from a chat
